title: Computer Vision
subtitle: Kernels, pooling, hierarchies, patches — and proof by occlusion

chapters.title: A Bank of Detectors
chapters.blurb: Three real kernels convolve a real image — and the checkerboard hides from both edge detectors exactly.

chapters.title: Keep What Fires
chapters.blurb: A real max pool: shift the image one pixel and 10 map cells change, but 0 pooled cells do.

chapters.title: Edges Become Shapes
chapters.blurb: A real three-layer stack turns a hollow square into edges, corners, and one blazing shape cell.

chapters.title: The Image Becomes a Sentence
chapters.blurb: Nine patches become tokens; a real softmax shows far-apart twins finding each other in one hop.

chapters.title: Where the Network Looks
chapters.blurb: The classifier is re-run 36 times behind a sliding gray patch — the saliency map is the receipt.
